note: tac_lite_create is a submodule of tac_lite. It hides taxonomy term options a user may not use on node add/edit forms via hook_form_alter (NOT node_access). Its only setting is a per-scheme boolean stored inside the parent config tac_lite.settings as tac_lite_config_scheme_<n>.tac_lite_create ('Visibility on create and edit forms' checkbox on the scheme tab). No config page/permission/service/schema of its own. All eval cases are grounded in that config flag and leave tac_lite_categories null, so no node grants and no node_access rebuild are involved. Baseline: no tac_lite_config_scheme_1 key.

evals.prompt: What does the tac_lite_create submodule do, and how is that different from what the main tac_lite module does?
evals.expected_output: tac_lite_create hides taxonomy term options a user may not use on node add/edit forms (via hook_form_alter), controlling which terms appear on content forms. The main tac_lite module instead uses Drupal's node_access grants to control view/update/delete of existing nodes. tac_lite_create does not control who can create content.

evals.prompt: How do you turn on tac_lite_create's term filtering for a tac_lite scheme, and where is that setting stored?
evals.expected_output: Tick 'Visibility on create and edit forms' on the tac_lite scheme tab (/admin/config/people/tac_lite/scheme_<n>). It is stored inside the parent config as tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_<n>.tac_lite_create (boolean). Schemes that grant update also imply form-term visibility.

evals.prompt: Which node-form field widgets does tac_lite_create filter term options on, and which users are exempt from the filtering?
evals.expected_output: It filters term options on select, radios, and checkboxes taxonomy widgets on node forms that reference a controlled vocabulary. Users with the 'administer tac_lite' permission are exempt and see all terms; a term that is the field's current default value is not removed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, does tac_lite scheme 1 have tac_lite_create's 'Visibility on create and edit forms' turned on? Inspect the live tac_lite configuration and answer.
evals.expected_output: Yes — tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1.tac_lite_create is true, so form-term visibility is enabled for scheme 1. Discoverable via drush cget tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, tac_lite scheme 1 is configured. Based on the scheme's permissions in the live tac_lite configuration, will tac_lite_create filter taxonomy terms on node add/edit forms for this scheme, even though its own 'Visibility on create and edit forms' checkbox is off? Explain why.
evals.expected_output: Yes: scheme 1 grants update (tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1.perms includes grant_update). tac_lite_create applies form-term filtering for any scheme where tac_lite_create is on OR that grants update, so update permission implies create/edit-form visibility even with the checkbox off. Discoverable via drush cget tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use tac_lite_create to make tac_lite scheme 1 filter taxonomy terms on content add/edit forms (enable 'Visibility on create and edit forms' for scheme 1). Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1.tac_lite_create is set to true (via the 'Visibility on create and edit forms' checkbox on the scheme tab, or by editing the scheme config array).

evals.prompt: On this site tac_lite scheme 1 currently has tac_lite_create's 'Visibility on create and edit forms' turned ON. Turn it OFF (disable form-term filtering for that scheme) without deleting the scheme, and apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: tac_lite.settings tac_lite_config_scheme_1 still exists but its tac_lite_create is false (untick the checkbox on the scheme tab, or set tac_lite_create => FALSE in the scheme config and save).
